target.title: feat(ios): PR1 brand color palette overhaul
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The iOS app used a partial, inconsistent color palette: Claw accent was `#C63E38` instead of the design guide’s `#E8302A`, semantic colors used raw `.orange/.green/.red`, and primary CTAs (Talk, push-relay sheet) still used `systemBlue`. There was no centralized surface/text token set for the upcoming design-system work.

## Why This Change Was Made

This is **PR 1** of the iOS design system plan: update `OpenClawBrand.swift` to the design-guide palette and route hardcoded colors through brand tokens. No navigation, typography, spacing, or component refactors in this PR.

## User Impact

- Primary actions and active tab states use **Claw Red** (`#E8302A`) consistently.
- Gateway/talk banners and privacy permission statuses use brand semantic colors (`ok` / `warn` / `danger`).
- Dark mode surfaces and text hierarchy tokens are defined for follow-up PRs (not yet applied to all views).

## Evidence

### Automated

- `OpenClawBrandTests` — semantic color contrast ≥ 4.5:1 in light and dark (iPhone 17 Simulator)
- `OpenClawSnapshotUITests/testConnectedGatewayTabs` — **TEST SUCCEEDED** (14 render paths)
- Pixel scan on Talk CTA region: **before** 12,615 blue pixels / 0 Claw Red → **after** 0 blue / 3,260 Claw Red (`#E8302A`)

### Before / after (simulator, `--openclaw-screenshot-mode`)

**Talk — Start Talk CTA (systemBlue → Claw Red)**

| Before (`upstream/main`) | After (this PR) |
|---|---|
| ![talk light before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/feat/ios-pr1-brand-colors/.github/proof/ios-pr1-colors/talk-light-before.png) | ![talk light after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/feat/ios-pr1-brand-colors/.github/proof/ios-pr1-colors/talk-light-after.png) |

**Talk — dark mode**

| Before | After |
|---|---|
| ![talk dark before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/feat/ios-pr1-brand-colors/.github/proof/ios-pr1-colors/talk-dark-before.png) | ![talk dark after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/feat/ios-pr1-brand-colors/.github/proof/ios-pr1-colors/talk-dark-after.png) |

**Settings — Connected status + accent tab**

| Before | After |
|---|---|
| ![settings light before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/feat/ios-pr1-brand-colors/.github/proof/ios-pr1-colors/settings-light-before.png) | ![settings light after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/feat/ios-pr1-brand-colors/.github/proof/ios-pr1-colors/settings-light-after.png) |

| Before | After |
|---|---|
| ![settings dark before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/feat/ios-pr1-brand-colors/.github/proof/ios-pr1-colors/settings-dark-before.png) | ![settings dark after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/feat/ios-pr1-brand-colors/.github/proof/ios-pr1-colors/settings-dark-after.png) |

**Onboarding — Continue button accent**

| Before (`#C63E38` era) | After (`#E8302A`) |
|---|---|
| ![onboarding before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/feat/ios-pr1-brand-colors/.github/proof/ios-pr1-colors/onboarding-welcome-before.png) | ![onboarding after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/feat/ios-pr1-brand-colors/.github/proof/ios-pr1-colors/onboarding-welcome-after.png) |

### Files changed

- `apps/ios/Sources/Design/OpenClawBrand.swift` — full palette (brand, surfaces, text, semantic)
- `SettingsProTab.swift`, `TalkProTab.swift`, `GatewayProblemView.swift`, `TalkRuntimeIssueBanner.swift`, `PrivacyAccessSectionView.swift` — remove hardcoded system/raw colors

## Real behavior proof (required for external PRs)

- Behavior or issue addressed: iOS brand colors and hardcoded accent/semantic colors aligned to design guide PR1
- Real environment tested: macOS, Xcode 16, iPhone 17 Simulator (iOS 26.3.1), Debug build with `--openclaw-screenshot-mode`
- Exact steps or command run after this patch:
  ```bash
  xcrun simctl launch booted ai.openclawfoundation.app     --openclaw-screenshot-mode     --openclaw-appearance light     --openclaw-initial-tab talk     --openclaw-initial-destination talk     --openclaw-sidebar-visibility hidden
  xcrun simctl io booted screenshot talk-after.png
  ```
  Before captures used the same commands against an `upstream/main` build (`ai.openclawfoundation.app`).
- Evidence after fix: before/after PNGs committed under `.github/proof/ios-pr1-colors/` (embedded above); pixel verification on Talk CTA shows `#E8302A` after vs system blue before
- Observed result after fix: Talk **Start Talk** button and active tab use Claw Red; Settings **Connected** uses brand ok green; onboarding **Continue** uses updated Claw Red
- What was not tested: physical device walkthrough; hosted push-relay sheet in live settings flow; Watch app approve buttons (out of scope)
- Proof limitations or environment constraints: tab screenshots use debug screenshot fixture mode (skips live gateway onboarding); before build required local `SwiftSources.input.xcfilelist` + `build/Version.xcconfig` copies for simulator compile

— [Joel Nishanth](https://offlyn.ai) · [offlyn.AI](https://offlyn.ai)
